title: Artwork Portfolio and Sales Webpage
objective: Create a mobile-responsive web page to display user's artwork portfolio with gallery layout, artwork details, contact methods for sales inquiries, optimized for friends and personal network viewing.

user_stories.title: U1: View artwork gallery as visitor
user_stories.goal: Browse the artwork portfolio in an attractive, easy-to-navigate layout
user_stories.benefit: Visitors can appreciate artwork quality, learn about each piece, and decide whether to make a purchase inquiry

user_stories.title: U2: Contact sales for artwork inquiries as friend
user_stories.goal: Reach out to the artist for sales inquiries through contact methods displayed on the page
user_stories.benefit: Friends can easily make purchase requests without barriers, supporting direct sales within personal network

requirements.description: U1-FR01: Page displays artwork in a responsive grid gallery layout that automatically adjusts column count based on viewport width (3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile)
U1-FR02: Each artwork card displays title, price, description, and image thumbnail on hover/click
U1-FR03: Clicking on any artwork card opens a full-size image modal with expanded details, gallery navigation (prev/next), and zoom functionality
U1-FR04: Navigation includes breadcrumb trail, filter by artwork type/category, and search functionality with real-time results
U2-FR01: Contact method section displays artist's email address, phone number, and social media handles (Instagram, Twitter) with clickable links

acceptance_criteria: U1-FR01-AC1: Gallery renders correctly on desktop (3 columns), tablet (2 columns), mobile (1 column)
U1-FR01-AC2: Images load without blur or compression artifacts in gallery view
U1-FR02-AC1: Hover state shows artwork details tooltip within 200ms of mouse over
U1-FR03-AC1: Modal opens on click and displays full-resolution image within 500ms
U2-FR01-AC1: All contact links (email, phone, social) open in new tab when clicked
UX-AC1: Page loads with all assets in under 2 seconds on 4G connection

steps: User lands on homepage gallery view with artwork thumbnails in responsive grid layout
User hovers over artwork thumbnail to preview title, price, description tooltip
User clicks artwork thumbnail to open full-size image modal with navigation controls
User browses gallery using breadcrumb trail and filters (by category/type)
User searches for specific artwork using search bar with real-time filtering
User scrolls down page; images lazy-load progressively for optimal performance
User views contact section at bottom to find artist's email, phone, social media links
User clicks any contact link which opens in new browser tab
Mobile users tap artwork to open modal; touch navigation works on next/prev controls
